backtest.method: Historical-only model selection and training, tested on current-season games with features from earlier dates only.

playerModel.method: Retrospective conditional test using explicitly listed nonparticipants and prior played-game minutes. Realized participation was not known before tipoff. Not an individual causal impact or a prospective injury forecast.

limitations: Current-season holdout is retrospective; player model uses realized participation and prior minutes as a conditional proxy, not verified impact or a causal effect.
